passages.context: The complete address was read for Francis's movement from the inheritance request through covetousness, accumulation, the reversal from many years to this night, the transfer question, and sharing. It is modern papal pastoral reception, not a decision of the brothers' civil case or a definition of one exhaustive economic program.
